title: The Seasons as Sacrifice
translation: When the gods spread the sacrifice with the Purusha as offering, spring was its ghee, summer its firewood, autumn its oblation.
translation_hi: जब देवताओं ने पुरुष को हवि बनाकर यज्ञ किया, तब वसंत उसका घी था, ग्रीष्म उसका ईंधन और शरद उसकी हवि।
science: The year itself is pictured as a sacrifice: the cycle of seasons, driven by the Earth's tilted orbit around the sun.
